Someone turned 1,407 AI-generated clothing references into an open-source virtual fitting room.

Pick an outfit, upload your photo, and generate a virtual try-on.

The gallery runs as a static site. Browsing, filtering, and Chinese/English search work without an API key.

Try-on adds an optional Go backend connected to your own image API or local ComfyUI.
